pairs.subject: codebase-scanning
pairs.evidence: src/components/modules/evaluator/CodebaseArcheologistView/BacklogTab.tsx:25 The Codebase Archeologist reports an empty backlog as a clean codebase, but its scanner returns [] when readdir fails and empty churn when git is unavailable, so a scan that could not run looks the same as a healthy result, which the golden path forbids.

techniques.evidence: src/components/modules/evaluator/CodebaseArcheologistView/AntiPatternsTab.tsx:63 Silent cap at 100 rows. The counter on line 52 prints hits.length, not 'top 100 of N', so the truncation is not disclosed. No skipped-sensor record exists in ArcheologistAnalysis either.

src/lib/codebase-archeologist.ts:75 Each finding's identity is a run-local counter rather than rule + normalized location + content digest, so findings cannot be deduplicated across sweeps and keep no history. The hit type also has no quoted matched content (the row shows only file:line).

src/components/modules/evaluator/CodebaseArcheologistView/OverviewTab.tsx:8 The health score subtracts per emitted instance, which counts emissions as work. No independent-cause count or stated relation is published beside the issue total.

src/components/modules/evaluator/CodebaseArcheologistView/index.tsx:91 Only the post-filter file count is shown. The traversal drops files by extension filter, maxDepth 8, and silently swallowed readdir failures, and none of those exclusions is counted or disclosed.

src/components/modules/evaluator/GDDComplianceView/EvidenceStrip.tsx:25 The GDD compliance evidence shows its age against a named staleness threshold instead of presenting old review evidence as current.

src/components/modules/evaluator/CodebaseArcheologistView/constants.ts:23 The rule roster (GENERATED_BODY, circular include, asset path, NewObject, deprecated API, god class) has no unused-code or reachability family.
src/components/modules/evaluator/CodebaseArcheologistView/index.tsx:48 The scanner reads the user's own local project path, not a foreign tree over a metered interface.

A case-insensitive search of the materials directory for findings/detector/dedup/codebase/dead code found nothing; the only 'scan' hits are a scanlines shader pattern.

pairs.subject: codebase-scanning
pairs.evidence: src/components/modules/project-setup/useProjectScan.ts:149 When the project directory listing throws, the error is swallowed ('Non-critical') and reported as 'No .uproject found', so hasProject becomes false and the derived next step offers Create project, a remediation for something the scan never actually checked.

techniques.evidence: src/components/modules/project-setup/useProjectScan.ts:98 Each sensor is isolated in its own try/catch (good), but the skip is not recorded. A failed engine-detection call shows as 'Not found' and is counted by missingRequirements toward 'Fix N Missing', so a failed read is scored as a missing tool.
